svg.text: Every bug-fix run, step by step
Claude Opus 5.5 · each row is one run, steps in the order they happened · not to time scale
A test failed on the unfixed code
Tests passed on the final code
Steps come from a logging wrapper around python in both arms and a file watcher; nothing in the prompt asked for tests.
